rationale: The only exception was a unit-of-measure difference: the supplier billed 480 EACH @ $2.00 against a PO for 40 CASE @ $24.00 with pack size 12 (vendor.json). Normalised per clause 2, quantity, unit price and line total reconcile exactly; receipt GR-7702 confirms 40 CASE delivered (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% equals the supplier's $72.00 (clause 5). UOM normalisation is not a defect (clause 11.1), so the invoice is a clean match payable at $1,032.00 with AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).
